title: Ku Vangamisa Leku Nweleke
intro: Anakanya hi leswi: moya-xiviri lowu ambaleke tinguvu letinene naswona wu rhendzeriweke hi xuma lexi nga ehleketiwiki. Munhu loyi a a pfumela leswaku rifuwo ra vona ri kumiwa hi vutlhari bya vona, a nga si tshama a amukela xihlovo xa mphakelo wa ntiyiso. Loko a famba exikarhi ka valandzeri va muprofeta wa matimba, munhu loyi u arile xirhambo xin’wana ni xin’wana xa ku titsongahata. Namuntlha, hi paluxa vumunhu bya xifaniso lexi rifuwo ra xona leri hlamarisaka ri veke ndhawu ya vona yo hetelela yo wisela eka yona.
clues: Ndzi hanye enkarhini wa muprofeta loyi a vitaneke tiko leri nonon’hwaka ntiyiso.
A ndzi ri xiphemu xa vaaki lava hlawuriweke, hambiswiritano mbilu ya mina yi fularhele rungula.
Nsuku ni silivhere swi ndzi khome ku tlula xileriso xin’wana ni xin’wana xa Xikwembu.
Swigwitsirisi swa mina swa xuma swi kurile swinene lerova ntlawa wa vavanuna lowu tiyeke a wu nga swi koti ku tlakusa swilotlelo hi ku nonoka.
A ndzi tibuma hi leswaku rifuwo ra mina ri nyikiwile mina hikwalaho ka vutivi bya mina.
Eku heteleleni, mina ni ndhawu ya mina hinkwayo leyi ndzi tshamaka eka yona hi mitiwe hi misava tanihi xilemukiso.

arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ ۖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا يَـٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ قَـٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ
verse: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune." (28:79)
